g.text: Know early, while you still have options.
60 live sources, read against every booking. The call comes before the route breaks.
Reroute via Rotterdam. Arrives 12 Oct, due 14 Oct.
Hamburg: up to 5 days late against 4 days of slack. Rotterdam adds 2 days, with no active risk.
Drafted a mail to Katrin Vogel, Bavaria Drivetrain.
We are bringing it in through Rotterdam instead of Hamburg, 2 days later than planned.
Hold the boxes instead of discharging into the strike. No other route lands any better.
Comms drafted the hold instruction to Maersk and the notice to Nordmed Pharma.
Cost avoided = €141,100 if nothing is done, minus €94,600 with these calls. From each synthetic booking's own terms.
60 sources, live, read together on every run
reads every source, flags what touches a booking
weighs slack against delay, prices every option
€141,100 if nothing is done, €94,600 with these calls
drafts the carrier and customer mail
amends the booking, moves the entry, sets the new ETA

svg.text: The earlier the call, the more options you have and the less it costs.

g.text: Automates the desk. Acts before the route breaks.
